general.description: Organic structures resembling sea urchin shells rather than true anemones. They can tolerate a wide range of temperatures and absorb energy from nearby stars.

color_variants.rule: Variant depends on star class, luminosity class, and planet type

Anemone.description: Single genus grouping with multiple visual/bioluminescent variants rather than distinct biological species.

notes: Different variants are NOT separate species but determined by environmental factors
Bioluminescent variants appear tied to specific stellar/luminosity combinations
Rocky Ice/Icy variants only appear in O-class star systems (Puniceus/Puniceum)

special_rules: Can spawn on rare thin atmospheres (confirmed Sulfur Dioxide), but primarily airless bodies
Strong dependency on star class AND luminosity (important for filtering)
Variant system is more complex than most genera (matrix-based instead of simple rules)
